# Jay Adoni (Jacob Adoni)

> Jacob Adoni, known as Jay Adoni, is a New York entrepreneur. He arrived in the United States from Israel in 1976, aged 17, founded LJ Simone in 1978 and PLV Studio in 2007, served as President of Pentland USA, and developed commercial real estate in Glen Cove, New York. Today he works in his Brooklyn shoe factory and runs a rare coin business.

This is Jay Adoni's official website. Facts on it are drawn from his biography and from The Dynamos: Who Are They, Anyway? by Brett Kingstone (John Wiley and Sons, 1987, ISBN 9780471858270), and press coverage in WWD, Inc. Magazine and The New York Times. Dollar figures are company sales or transaction values, not personal income.

## Pages
- [Home](https://jayadoni.com/): Jay Adoni (Jacob Adoni), New York entrepreneur: founder of LJ Simone and PLV Studio, now running a Brooklyn shoe factory and a rare coin business.
- [Facts](https://jayadoni.com/facts.html): Quick facts about Jacob Adoni, known as Jay Adoni: where he is from, the companies he founded, his real estate work and what he does today.
- [Story](https://jayadoni.com/story.html): The life story of Jay Adoni: arriving from Israel in 1976 with $20, odd jobs, and founding LJ Simone at 19 in New York.
- [LJ Simone](https://jayadoni.com/lj-simone.html): Jay Adoni founded LJ Simone in 1978 at 19 and grew the handbag and shoe brand to over $120 million in annual sales before 1993.
- [The Dynamos](https://jayadoni.com/the-dynamos.html): Jay Adoni of Admos Shoe Corporation, profiled in The Dynamos: over 250 employees and a three day path from Italy to the salesman.
- [Pentland USA](https://jayadoni.com/finance.html): After selling LJ Simone to Pentland Brands in 1993, Jay Adoni stayed on to lead its American business as President of Pentland USA.
- [Real Estate](https://jayadoni.com/real-estate.html): Jay Adoni developed supermarkets and a shopping center in Glen Cove, New York, through Harbor Park Realty, and managed the 2001 sale to the Ahold group.
- [PLV Studio](https://jayadoni.com/plv-studio.html): In 2007 Jay Adoni founded PLV Studio, maker of Pour La Victoire and Kelsi Dagger. VMG Partners acquired a majority interest in 2014.
- [Modern Vice](https://jayadoni.com/modern-vice.html): Jay Adoni opened a Brooklyn shoe factory that grew into The Adoni Group. He was a TAG, Inc. director and consults for Modern Vice.
- [Keep Healthy](https://jayadoni.com/keep-healthy.html): Jay Adoni has served as CEO of Keep Healthy Inc, a fast growing snack food company making dried fruit snacks and fruit based bars.
- [Brands](https://jayadoni.com/brands.html): Every brand in Jay Adoni's career: LJ Simone, Admos Shoe Corp., Pentland USA, Pour La Victoire, Kelsi Dagger, Modern Vice and more.
- [Timeline](https://jayadoni.com/timeline.html): Jay Adoni, New York entrepreneur, year by year: LJ Simone, Pentland USA, Glen Cove real estate, Modern Vice, PLV Studio and Keep Healthy.
- [In His Words](https://jayadoni.com/in-his-words.html): Jay Adoni on opportunity, speed and hard work, in his own words as quoted in Brett Kingstone's book The Dynamos: Who Are They, Anyway?
- [Press](https://jayadoni.com/press.html): Jay Adoni in WWD, Inc. Magazine and The New York Times: Steve Madden names him an early mentor, plus Pour La Victoire and Glen Cove coverage.
- [Photos](https://jayadoni.com/photos.html): Photos of Jay Adoni, New York entrepreneur: portraits in New York, in the shoe studio, at the workbench, in the boardroom and at home.
- [Contact](https://jayadoni.com/contact.html): Contact Jay Adoni about partnerships, new ventures, real estate and press. Founder of LJ Simone and PLV Studio in New York.
